prerequisites: Knowledge from Mathematics and Physics courses is required. In particular, a basic understanding of differential and integral calculus, as well as vector calculus, is necessary.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will acquire knowledge in fluid mechanics.
Students will acquire skills related to the development of computer simulations aimed at modeling fluid-mechanical systems.

assessment_rules: The exam consists of an oral test covering the topics presented during lectures. It aims to assess both the understanding of theoretical aspects and the ability to reason through applied problems.
bibliography: Nguyen N-T. e Wereley S. T., Fundamentals and Applications of Microfluidics, Artech House ed., 2019
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
